    The least realization and the image closure #

    • Corollary 4.7. An image-closed subcategory Z has a least realization (leastRealization), obtained from the greatest realization of Zᵒᵖ in the opposite category (Construction 4.6 is the dual of Construction 4.3). Every pretorsion theory with intersection Z lies between the least and the greatest realization (realization_bounds); with Proposition 3.8 this makes the realizations of Z a complete lattice.
    • Corollary 4.9 (Auslander–Smalø, Proposition 4.3). Gen Z ∩ Cogen Z is the smallest image-closed subcategory containing Z (isImageClosed_gen_inf_cogen, le_gen_inf_cogen, gen_inf_cogen_le).
